mapping.summary: Direct bank API for payments, statements and matching
claims: Direct bank API connection with mutual TLS, no middleware
Sends SEPA Credit Transfer pain.001 from payment journal lines
Validates company data, SWIFT, IBAN and amount before submission
Live payment status on journal line: accepted, settled, rejected
Imports camt.053 end-of-day and camt.052 intraday statements via API
Scheduled unattended daily statement import via job queue
Four-tier IBAN- and history-based matching proposes customer, vendor or employee
Match reason shown in FactBox; posting stays manual
Certificate stored encrypted with 30-day expiry warning and sandbox mode
Logs every API call with full request/response XML
Supports Swedbank Baltic Gateway for Latvia, Estonia, Lithuania
Included with JEMEL Latvian Localization license
